baseline: A correct baseline models each positive cell as a vertex and each legal move as a connection: this is a graph. Number a cell as row×column-count+column. d[a,b] denotes the shortest distance between cells a and b; k is an intermediate cell. Compute every pair’s shortest distance: initialize neighbors to 1, self-distance to 0, and others to infinity. Allow each vertex k as an intermediate stop and update d[a,b] = min(d[a,b], d[a,k]+d[k,b]). This is the Floyd–Warshall baseline. With V = m×n cells, it takes O(V³) time and O(V²) space: about 15.6 billion updates at 2500 cells. We only need distances between consecutive sorted targets, not every pair.

baseline: 正确基线：把每个正数格看作一个点，合法的一步连接两个点，这叫图。给格子编号：行×列数+列。d[a,b] 表示编号 a、b 两格的最短距离，k 是中转格。为所有点对计算最短距离：先把相邻点距离设为 1、自己到自己设为 0，其余设为无穷，再依次允许每个点作为中转点，更新 d[a,b] = min(d[a,b], d[a,k]+d[k,b])。这就是 Floyd–Warshall 基线。V = m×n 个格时，时间 O(V³)、空间 O(V²)；2500 格意味着约 156 亿次更新。我们只需要排序后相邻目标的距离，不需要所有点对。
